race.comment: DURHAM (1) is in career-best form and made it two wins from his last three starts recently when a comfortable winner at BM68 level over this course and distance. Still gets in okay after the claim for Ingelse who has been in the saddle in each of his three wins. Hard to tip against. OCTANE REIGN (2) made steady ground to get up for third last time out over 1600m at Moe. Failed over this trip at Mornington two back which is the query, but that Victorian provincial form should stack up. KAZARU (6) showed a glimpse of form when 3.5 lengths behind DURHAM here recently. Fitter for three runs back from a spell and the engagement of Callow is a solid lead. Promising stayer SWAN DANCE (8) has won two from two this prep, both out of town. Sure to run well again with the light weight. SILVALOA (3) did a good job to salute on the outer track seven days ago. In contention again.
